{
  "name": "cache-warmer",
  "version": "0.12.2",
  "description": "Keep the main conversation's prompt cache warm by automatically forking its last request, tools denied and billed like any request, shortly before the cache expires; switch its lifetime between 5m and 1h, and show each refresh's cost and estimated saving.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Paul B. Kim"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/paulbkim-dev/claude-code-cache-warmer",
  "repository": "https://github.com/paulbkim-dev/claude-code-cache-warmer",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "prompt-cache",
    "cache",
    "cost",
    "mod"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "ttl": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Prompt cache lifetime",
      "description": "Main-conversation cache lifetime this mod sets; refreshes run at 90% of it. 1h writes cost 2x input instead of 1.25x.",
      "default": "1h",
      "options": [
        "5m",
        "1h"
      ]
    },
    "idle5m": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Idle refreshes, 5m",
      "description": "Refreshes a 5-minute cache gets while the session is idle, 0 to 20; each still needs the $0.05 expected saving.",
      "default": 5,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 20
    },
    "idle1h": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Idle refreshes, 1h",
      "description": "Refreshes a 1-hour cache gets while the session is idle, 0 to 20; each still needs the $0.05 expected saving.",
      "default": 5,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 20
    },
    "band": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Refresh band",
      "description": "The band above the prompt while a refresh runs and for 5 seconds after it: default shows Clawd beside the notice, simplified one line, off nothing.",
      "default": "default",
      "options": [
        "default",
        "simplified",
        "off"
      ]
    }
  }
}
